cover_letter:
Dear Qargo team,

I'm excited to apply for the UI/UX Designer position in Ghent. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, I've developed a keen eye for UI consistency and usability. At Episto, I build and maintain client websites in WordPress using Elementor and Astra, ensuring responsive design and clear content hierarchy. I've also implemented structured data and run technical SEO/GEO audits on my project mirook.com, which taught me how to design for both traditional and AI-powered search engines.

While my experience is not yet two years, I've already taken ownership of design improvements on client sites, from page layouts to component consistency. I'm comfortable with Figma and AI tools, and I'm quick to learn new systems like Storybook. I understand the importance of accessible design principles and have applied them to ensure clarity and usability across devices. My background in front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript) gives me a solid understanding of how design translates to code, which I believe will help me collaborate effectively with your engineers.

I'm drawn to Qargo's mission to optimise logistics through intuitive software. The opportunity to be the sole designer and build a design system from the ground up is exactly the kind of challenge I'm looking for. I'm based in Zwijndrecht, just outside Antwerp, and I'm fluent in English with B1 Dutch, currently improving. I'm eager to engage with customers and use their feedback to inform design decisions.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my skills can contribute to Qargo's design vision.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
